title: Ghislaine Maxwell's TerraMar Project as an elite offshore trading network
place_text: oceans, near Antarctica; Richard Branson's island

tellings.quote: it's like this elite network of trading routes trading routes and shipping containers going around places like near Antarctica off the grid and it was being held by all these [ __ ] huge elites.

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about the TerraMar Project, an ocean group run in the 2010s by Ghislaine Maxwell, a British socialite tied to the financier Jeffrey Epstein. Anderson says it was really an elite network of trading routes and shipping containers moving around remote places like the waters near Antarctica, off the grid, with links to the businessman Richard Branson's island. If true, it would mean the very rich were running a hidden trade beyond anyone's oversight.
